source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 2.1 frames problem setup, evaluation criteria, initial solutions, and optional background knowledge as human-provided inputs, while Section 3.2 reports external mathematicians suggesting problems and advising how to formulate them, so paper-facing mathematical benchmark claims need populated expert-guided formulation evidence rather than only a metadata schema
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has an optional formulation metadata contract and runtime provenance report for contributor roles, formulation notes, objective/evaluator rationale, parameter scope, background references, and review/signoff readiness, but does not claim populated expert-reviewed matrix or constructive-math benchmark formulation records, external expert identity records, problem-owner identity records, evaluator/result-artifact linkage, parameter-scope signoff, background-reference artifact links, review timestamps or versions, anti-gaming review evidence, paper-facing certification rows, review/signoff artifact links, benchmark-result linkage, or AlphaEvolve expert-guided formulation parity.
